Customer Service Principles
Ref: Patient’s Rights Charter. Department of Health, SA. https://www.westerncape.gov.za/
general-publication/patients-rights-and-responsibilities. Presentation prepared by Dr T. Baillie-Stanton
Improving the Patient Experience
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Patient centered care
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Approachability
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Feedback on delays
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Prompt attention to 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
- pain
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
- bleeding
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
- vomiting
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
- actual reason for visit to ED
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Quality medical care is NOT the same
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
as patient satisfaction
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Patient’s perception of care is important 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Documentation of interactions 
Patient’s Rights
Patient’s Responsibilities
All patients are entitled to:
Everyone has the responsibility to:
A healthy + safe environment
Take care of one’s own health
Participation in decision-making
Care for + protect the environment
Access to health care
Respect the rights of other patients +
respect the rights of health care providers (HCP)
Choice of health services
Treatment by a named provider
Use the heath services properly – not abuse it
Confidentiality + privacy
Know local health service + what is offered
Informed consent
Provide relevant + accurate information for 
diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation or counseling
Refusal of treatment
Second opinion
Advise HCP about end-of-life decisions
Continuity of care
Comply with prescribed medications
Right to complain about health services
Enquire about costs + arrange for payment
Knowledge of one’s health medical aid scheme
Take care of health records in your possession
